notes.content:
A survivor game that focuses on overcoming monsters and monsters in various ways. Use the Dharma Iron Fist falling from the sky on the monsters that need to be enlightened, or directly take out the Gatling gun for physical salvation!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44197405/68d15b9da078ee653a5b717e40c33602af77d998.gif[/img]

There are up to 12 optional characters, each with 3 advanced talents that fundamentally change the gameplay! Provide you with a variety of human choices to beat monsters and monsters!

Choose your favorite Taoist companion to practice dual cultivation, and show off your love with him amidst the overwhelming monsters that attack you!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44197405/266a2e9588eef3b46353d01bcea2c107835b63e8.gif[/img]

*Adjust and strengthen spell skills to stimulate stronger elemental reactions
*Strengthen the talent groups of each hero to make the combination more free and powerful
*There is much more to come

The game has released a free DEMO on Steam. Interested friends can also experience this unique Westward Journey world first: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2450100/_/

notes.title: 【Jan.31 | V0.901】New abilities, new mode and many other new stuff. And DEMO!
notes.content:
As the power of chaos further strengthens, the entire world of Journey to the West becomes more and more strange. The heroes suddenly learnt some very powerful abilities. The plants growing in the ground  joined the battle to defend Tang Seng. Anyway, it’s getting really weird!

1. New Abilities for Heroes: Now all heroes have three unique passive abilities. Unlock them on Talent surface to kick monsters' ass(es).

2. New Mode [b]Farming & Defense[/b]: Plant your plants to protect Tang Monk. Due to the unstability of Chaos Power, adventurers may meet some strange situations in this mode. We will optimize this mode in the future update. Thanks for your understanding! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44197405/baa624c4e4ba33f3d96609a264cb1f10fb17c0c2.png[/img]

3. Adjusted some values
4. Optimized the talent tree: the current talents have been re-planned and designed;
5. Optimized the UI interface;
6. Optimized some operations.

We also launched a demo in this update, so more adventurers will be able to experience the charm of Journey to the West Survivors.

Thanks for you love and support to us. If you have any problem or feedback about Journey to the West Survivors, please tell us in [url=https://discord.gg/UDTwcZdvap][b]DISCORD[/b][/url].

notes.title: 0.830 版本更新 无尽难度降低
notes.content:
0.830 版本更新  无尽难度降低
 
1、蛋糕怪改成对话选择增加世界难度；
 
2、无尽模式、娱乐模式怪物数值整体降低40%;
 
3、李元霸改成低于30%血召唤，高于40%血时刷新CD；

notes.title: 0.8259 版本更新 Bug修复 无尽模式完善
notes.content:
1、修复召唤打人不扣血Bug；
 
2、修复少部分玩家鼠标轴错位Bug;
 
3、无尽模式和娱乐模式，怪物基础数值降低；
 
4、地图四角各有一只蛋糕怪，击败蛋糕怪后时间缩短200分钟，但是提高一个世界等级，怪物强度会大幅度提升，最多把时间缩短至剩余60分钟（备注：无敌之前不要去刷蛋糕怪）
 
5、【帮助】菜单增加对无尽模式的说明；

notes.title: 0.8257版本更新 召唤天赋 道侣天赋
notes.content:
0.8257版本更新  召唤天赋 道侣天赋
 
1、新增两个门派天赋，秦王府、盘丝洞

 
2、盘丝洞是道侣专精天赋，可以实现道侣复活，道侣闪回玩家角色位置，传功不消除玩家技能；
 
3、秦王府是召唤专精天赋，新增精英召唤单位——李元霸，可以实现大范围金属性AOE；

notes.title: 0.8256版本更新 技能加强
notes.content:
1、智慧权杖、瑞士军刀、冻鸡箭、刀剑共鸣大幅度加强；
 
2、人参果加强，可以永久提升点1点悟性；
 
3、混混刀法系列增加吸血；
 
4、中毒可以传染给附近一个敌人；
 
5、共鸣取消上限，但是五级之上只是影响伤害，不增加数量；
 
6、八戒技能伤害增加；

notes.title: 0.8255版本更新 图鉴完善
notes.content:
1、修复部分角色升级不提升属性BUG；
 
2、完善了小怪和BOSS的图鉴；
 
3、修复了无尽模式重叠法宝BUG；

notes.title: The Early Access version of West Journey Survivor will be unlocked on August 23,
The Early Access of Journey to West Survivor will be released on August 23
notes.content:
The Early Access version of West Journey Survivor is scheduled to be released on August 23, 2023. This exclusive edition offers the following features: 
1. A selection of 12 unique characters for players to choose from.
2. Five diverse and immersive scene maps.
3. Multiple gameplay modes including simple mode, ordinary mode, difficult mode, hell mode, true fairy mode, and endless mode.
4. An extensive collection of 200 skills or resonances.
5. The inclusion of a farming mode experience version.

Furthermore, regular updates will introduce additional skills, characters, bosses, and monsters to enhance your gaming experience. We warmly welcome you to join our community of supervisors!
